summary: A hospital appointment booking system that allows patients to schedule, reschedule, and view medical appointments online while enabling hospital staff and administrators to manage schedules and patient records.
assumptions: The system will support patients and hospital staff via web and mobile browsers.
Authentication will be handled via standard email and password with optional two-factor authentication.
Payment processing for consultations is out of scope for the initial MVP.
Integration with existing Electronic Health Record systems is assumed to use standard FHIR APIs.

requirements.text: Patients can create an account and log in securely using their email address.
Patients can search for available doctors by specialty and date.
Patients can book an available appointment slot with a selected doctor.
Patients can view their upcoming and past appointments.
Patients can cancel or reschedule an existing appointment up to 24 hours in advance.
Administrators can add, update, or deactivate doctor profiles and working schedules.
The system sends an email notification to the patient upon successful appointment booking.
All patient health data must be encrypted at rest and in transit using industry-standard protocols.
95% of search and booking pages must load in under 2 seconds.
The system must maintain an uptime availability of at least 99.9% during standard operating hours.
The user interface must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

epics.title: Patient Account Management
epics.description: Enables patients to securely register, log in, and manage their personal accounts.

epics.title: Appointment Scheduling
epics.description: Allows patients to search for doctors, book appointments, view history, and manage changes.

epics.title: Administration and Staff Management
epics.description: Allows administrators to manage doctor profiles, schedules, and working hours.

epics.title: Platform and Quality
epics.description: Ensures security, performance, uptime, accessibility, and notifications for the system.

stories.i_want: to create an account and log in securely using my email address
stories.so_that: I can access my personal medical appointments and data safely
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the registration page, when I submit valid email and password, then my account is created.
Given I have an account, when I enter correct credentials, then I am successfully logged in.

stories.i_want: to search for available doctors by specialty and date
stories.so_that: I can find the right medical professional for my needs
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, when I select a specialty and date, then I see a list of available doctors.
Given no doctors are available, when I search, then an appropriate message is displayed.

stories.i_want: to book an available appointment slot with a selected doctor
stories.so_that: I can secure a time for my medical consultation
acceptance_criteria: Given I view a doctor profile, when I select an open slot and confirm, then the appointment is booked.
Given a slot is already taken, when I try to book it, then an error is shown.

stories.i_want: to view my upcoming and past appointments
stories.so_that: I can keep track of my medical schedule
acceptance_criteria: Given I navigate to my dashboard, when I view appointments, then I see both upcoming and past visits clearly separated.
Given I have no appointments, when I check the view, then an empty state message appears.

stories.i_want: to cancel or reschedule an existing appointment up to 24 hours in advance
stories.so_that: I can adjust my schedule when unexpected conflicts arise
acceptance_criteria: Given my appointment is more than 24 hours away, when I choose to reschedule or cancel, then the action succeeds.
Given my appointment is less than 24 hours away, when I try to cancel, then the system prevents it.

stories.i_want: to add, update, or deactivate doctor profiles and working schedules
stories.so_that: patients always see accurate availability and staff information
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as admin, when I fill out a new doctor profile, then it is successfully created.
Given an existing doctor profile, when I update their working hours, then the schedule reflects the changes immediately.

stories.i_want: all patient health data to be encrypted at rest and in transit
stories.so_that: sensitive medical information remains secure and compliant
acceptance_criteria: Given data is stored in the database, when checked, then it uses industry-standard encryption at rest.
Given data is transmitted over the network, when intercepted, then it is encrypted using TLS standards.

stories.i_want: 95% of search and booking pages to load in under 2 seconds
stories.so_that: users experience a fast and responsive application
acceptance_criteria: Given a user performs a search action, when measured under normal load, then response time is under 2 seconds.
Given analytics are reviewed, when checking page performance, then 95% compliance is maintained.

stories.i_want: the system to maintain uptime availability of at least 99.9% during operating hours
stories.so_that: patients and staff can rely on the service without disruption
acceptance_criteria: Given standard operating hours, when uptime is monitored, then availability meets or exceeds 99.9%.
Given an unexpected outage occurs, when detected, then automated alerts notify the operations team.

stories.i_want: the user interface to comply with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards
stories.so_that: users with disabilities can use the booking system effectively
acceptance_criteria: Given an accessibility audit tool is run, when scanning pages, then all WCAG 2.1 AA rules pass.
Given a user navigates via keyboard only, when using core flows, then all elements are reachable and operable.

signals.message: CPM duration is 44 h (7.5 working days); 3 of 34 tasks (9%) are critical.
2 of 3 sprints are packed to at least 98% of capacity, so there is no buffer for estimation error.
Capacity-feasible plan is 30 working days (3 sprints) against a CPM minimum of 7.5 working days: ratio 4.09x.

risks.title: Capacity Constraint and High Sprint Load
risks.description: According to the capacity-plan, the capacity-feasible plan spans 30 working days across 3 sprints compared to a critical-path minimum of 7.5 working days, resulting in a ratio of 4.09x (SG-03). Furthermore, the sprint-load capacity data shows that 2 of 3 sprints are packed to at least 98% of capacity, leaving no buffer for estimation errors or unexpected delays (SG-02).
risks.mitigation: Reallocate tasks to reduce sprint utilization below 98%, and re-evaluate the dependency constraints driving the 4.09x schedule expansion.

risks.title: Critical Path Vulnerability on Infrastructure Tasks
risks.description: The critical-path schedule indicates a duration of 44 hours (7.5 working days), with 3 out of 34 tasks (9%) identified as critical (SG-01). These tasks include configuring high availability infrastructure, implementing uptime monitoring, and verifying disaster recovery. Any slip in these critical tasks will directly impact the project timeline.
risks.mitigation: Closely monitor the critical path tasks and assign experienced personnel to ensure they complete within the 44-hour estimate.
